Together with Orbem we sought out new applications for their innovative MRI technology. We conducted various expert interviews across Europe along the entire agricultural value chain. Out of these insights, we developed a product vision and an accompanying business case. In the end, we presented Orbem with a functional prototype and an elaborated product vision, including all outcomes of the product development lifecycle.
